title: Four skills, one rule: the model writes JSON, never markup
subtitle: What the visual-artifacts work in this repo does and where it stops

sections.title: A prompt becomes one file you can open anywhere
sections.text: Diagrams, dashboards, videos and explainers now share a theme, a checker and a rule: the model fills in JSON and a script renders it.
points: Each output is one local file with no network at build or view time.
Checks run before the render, so a bad spec fails with a path and a fix.
One set of themes keeps every artifact in the same family.

sections.title: Each skill covers one kind of artifact

items.title: make-diagram
items.text: Architecture, flow, sequence and state diagrams with zoom and hover tracing.

items.title: make-dashboard
items.text: Charts and KPI pages built from local data files.

items.title: make-motion
items.text: Short animated videos, previewed locally and exported to MP4.

items.title: make-explainer
items.text: Recaps, checklists, concept pages and slide decks like this one.

sections.title: Every build follows the same four steps

items.title: Write the outline
items.text: Typed sections in one JSON file.

items.title: Validate it
items.text: Schema, file references and prose rules.

items.title: Render it
items.text: Themed HTML with fonts and script inlined.

items.title: Look at it
items.text: A headless check opens the result and reports problems.

sections.title: An outline stays consistent where a hand-written page drifts

columns.title: Hand-written page
points: Spacing changes from page to page.
A font or script may come from a CDN.

columns.title: Generated from an outline
points: The content security policy blocks the network.

sections.title: A slide is a section with a claim for a title
A slide that is too full is an error, not a warning
sections.caption: Over the limit, validation says which slide and how to split it.

sections.title: Keys that work in the deck
sections.text: Left and right arrows, Space, Page Up and Page Down move between slides. Home and End jump to the first and last. **O** opens the outline. A link such as `#slide-3` opens that slide, and the last slide is remembered.

sections.title: A tall slide scrolls inside itself
sections.text: A slide taller than the screen scrolls inside itself. Space scrolls it first and moves on at the bottom, and a table that scrolls sideways keeps the arrow keys while it has focus.

sections.title: Next, the diagram, chart and video sections land in the deck too
sections.text:
- Diagram and chart sections reuse the sibling skills.
- Video sections link a clip made by make-motion.
- The headless check will open every slide.
